name: Mantaraymon
main_effect:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Attacking] Trash any 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn.
